title: Codeograph Corpus Synthesis
description: Non-deterministic cross-domain synthesis of the whole corpus, produced by LLM Pass 2 from the Pass 1 annotations. Kept out of graph.json so the deterministic graph stays a function of the corpus alone. Not produced when --ast-only is used.

schema_version.description: Version of this file's format. The pattern pins the major; minor and patch vary within it.

description.description: 2-3 sentences describing what the system does in plain business English.

architecture_pattern.description: Overall architectural pattern (e.g., 'Layered Controller-Service-Repository with domain-driven packaging').

domains.description: Echoed list of business domain names from the prompt.

cross_domain_dependencies.description: Concrete cross-domain dependencies — injected fields only, not general patterns.

from_class.description: The fully-qualified class name that holds the dependency.

from_domain.description: The business domain the source class belongs to.

to_class.description: The class being injected or imported from another domain.

to_domain.description: The business domain the target class belongs to.
